# Scenario catalog

The bundled scenario packs. Run one from the console's **Launch** page, or `pulsebench run <name>`. Edit them in the **Scenarios** builder or as YAML ([scenario-schema.md](scenario-schema.md)).

| Scenario | Topology | Load | Duration | Fraud campaigns | p99 budget (e2e / hot) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `app-scam-mules` | gateway-kafka | 500 TPS | 2 min | app_scam_mule | 150 / 100 ms | Authorised push-payment scams funnelled into mule accounts (fan-in of 6+ senders per payee). |
| `atm-cashout-unlimited` | gateway-kafka | 500 TPS | 2.5 min | atm_cashout | 150 / 100 ms | Unlimited-operation ATM cash-out at t=40s (2,000 cards x 3-10 withdrawals in minutes) - a load spike plus ATM velocity rules. |
| `ato-campaign` | gateway-kafka | 500 TPS | 2 min | account_takeover | 150 / 100 ms | Account takeover wave - new devices + foreign IPs + high-value e-commerce. |
| `ato-sessions` | flink-inline | 400 TPS | 2 min | background mix | 150 / 100 ms | Account takeover seen across message types (pipeline payments-ext): failed logins from a new device and a credential change before the fraudulent payments, card tokens provisioned to wallets, tampered devices. Flink scores inline, so the customer and card features fed by logins are exact; the rule set baseline-ext adds candidate rules over them (replay it against baseline with `pulsebench rules-whatif`). Needs `make up PIPELINE=payments-ext`. |
| `baseline-10k` | gateway-kafka | 10,000 TPS | 10 min | background mix | 150 / 100 ms | The target - 10,000 TPS sustained for 10 min through the async gateway with realistic dependencies; run on the gke-l4 overlay (a 4-vCPU dev box cannot host it). |
| `black-friday` | gateway-kafka | spike 400 -> 1,200 TPS | 3 min | background mix | 150 / 100 ms | Diurnal peak - 3x traffic spike for 60 s mid-run with background fraud; tests headroom and sustainability. |
| `capacity-saturation` | gateway-kafka | step 500 -> 3,000 TPS | 3 min | background mix | 150 / 100 ms | GPU-like model capacity (8 workers, dynamic batching 32 / 2 ms, 12 ms per batch + 0.2 ms/row) under a 500 -> 3000 TPS ramp - queueing appears as load rises. |
| `card-testing-wave` | gateway-kafka | 500 TPS | 2 min | card_testing | 150 / 100 ms | A card-testing wave at t=30s (40 cards hitting one merchant) on top of background fraud; CARD_TESTING / merchant burst rules must fire. |
| `echo-calibration` | echo-kafka | 2,000 TPS | 60 s | background mix | 50 / 10 ms | Instrument floor. Gateway answers immediately (no features/model); measures Kafka + driver overhead. |
| `eos-cost` | flink-inline | 500 TPS | 90 s | background mix | 150 / 100 ms | Exactly-once delivery cost - Flink-inline with transactional sink; consumers read_committed see decisions only at checkpoint commit (expect e2e >= checkpoint interval -> FAIL). |
| `everyday-baseline` | gateway-kafka | 500 TPS | 2 min | background mix | 150 / 100 ms | Legitimate traffic only (no fraud) - measures the false-positive floor of the rule set + model. |

| `flink-inline-smoke` | flink-inline | 500 TPS | 90 s | background mix | 150 / 100 ms | Topology A - Flink does everything (stateful features + async profile lookup + model + policy) at 500 TPS. |
| `flows-inline` | flink-inline | 500 TPS | 90 s | background mix | 150 / 100 ms | The flows-smoke traffic (transfers and card payments as their linked messages, assembled by Flink) with Flink scoring inline (topology A), so there is no extra hop between assembly and decision. 500 TPS, verified exactly. |
| `flows-smoke` | gateway-kafka | 500 TPS | 60 s | background mix | 150 / 100 ms | Transfers arrive as their six linked messages (initiation, device context, payee check, SCA, submission, status) and card purchases as theirs (3-D Secure result, authorisation, capture, reversal, refund, chargeback); Flink assembles each into the unified event before the gateway scores it. 500 TPS, verified exactly, with rules over the transaction context. |

Score it with a model trained on fraud-train (seed 7). |
